title: Joint Petition of Marathon Lines, Inc. and Peter Pan Bus Lines, Inc. requesting the Department, pursuant to G.L. c. 159A, secs. 7A and 11A to assign and transfer CPCN No. 3786 and charter license Nos. 17699 and 8760-A to Peter Pan Bus Lines, Inc. and to change the base of operation and of garaging of the charter service operated under charter license No. 8760-A to 555 Atlantic Avenue, Boston, Massachusetts.
